name: Miss Ashley's Berry Patch
tagline: Link to Miss Ashley's Berry Patch Facebook Page at https://www.facebook.com/missashleysberrypatch
description: A small pumpkin patch in 763 Regents Park Road, NC, Miss Ashley's Berry Patch grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples. The patch is busiest in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
